title: AI Adoption Framework
description: An AI adoption framework for a B2B SaaS company — translating AI capabilities into practical operator workflows across growth, marketing, and product. Built to compound, not to impress.
problem: The team wanted to add AI but had no framework for evaluating where it creates real leverage vs. where it creates noise.
system: Adoption playbook: use-case prioritization, workflow redesign for AI-assisted execution, tooling decisions, and a rollout model that keeps decision quality high at every handoff.
artifact: Structured adoption framework with prioritized use cases, prompt templates, and operating guidelines.
outcome: Shared roadmap and clear criteria for where AI creates compounding value — across growth, marketing, and product, not just cost savings.
